The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of crisp relational learning with online weight learning in MLN is a promising approach for online learning in complex domains.
the combination of online crisp relational structure learning and online weight learning in MLNs can be successfully used to learn complex event patterns from data.
the combination of crisp relational structure with weights can be a powerful approach for online learning of complex event patterns.
